name: Worship God
overview: Scripture calls believers to worship God with reverence and humility, as seen in Psalms 95:6 where we are invited to bow down and kneel before the LORD our Maker. True worship is not merely external but must be done in spirit and truth, reflecting the heart's sincerity, as Jesus taught in John 4:23-24. Worship involves praising God with all our breath and acknowledging His power and presence, as emphasized in Psalms 150:1,6. Even when tempted by worldly glory, as in Matthew 4:8, worship belongs solely to God, affirming His supreme authority.
